requirements.text: Unknown capability never executes.
Policy deny or unknown never executes.
Invalid input never executes.
Exact capability version is bound before execution.
Invalid output cannot be returned as success.
Required missing, stale, or wrong-bound evidence cannot support success.
Request, adapter, or provider metadata cannot supply KORPUS authorization.
Effectful operations require explicit effect authorization.
Effectful operations require idempotency binding.
Idempotency conflicts cannot execute.
Ambiguous effect timeout becomes OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.
Required audit persistence is a success precondition.
Secrets do not enter user output or telemetry labels.
Remote and MCP metadata remains untrusted discovery data.
Schema or effect drift cannot silently widen an enabled capability.
Disabled gateway preserves existing product behavior.
Canonical KORPUS policy, evidence, and audit remain authoritative.
Exact-state clean-room reproduction passes.
Separate-context verifier reproduces blocking controls.
Final production authority remains with Owner.
